additionalIndependentExecution.scope: Actual recovery cache/slot/main: forced local publication failure preserves result and first/cleanup errors, releases slot, old ACK cannot release/cancel next request.
Actual guaranteed terminal slot/drain always attempts Serial priority, fans out independently to enabled generation-aware BLE and ready WiFi, each failure counted; publish/release gate enforced.

reviewedInvariants: IDF5.5.5 USB write_bytes makes full BYTEBUF copy or returns zero; app slot can be released after complete admission, driver retains no app pointer.
TX original absolute enqueue deadline persists through driver waits/checkpoints/short writes; partial record owns slot until complete or bounded discard followed by LF boundary.
No USB TX FILE lock; pool/stats/queue spinlocks are not held across driver waits or work checkpoints.
WorkBudget observes actual IDLE0 via idle hook, has no WDT feed, one bounded vTaskDelay(1), seven independent single-task worker states, and no loop waiting for idle.
BLE/Transport/AsyncLog/Serial RX/WiFi RX drain paths reach checkpoints; full batches preserve notification work; WiFi checkpoint is outside SDK/LWIP callbacks and locks.
RECOVER local ACK admission gates hardware execution; stale identity is rejected without touching newer config.
Restart budget rejection and hardware-touched recovery failure put mode NONE/DEGRADED, stop ADS, retain first/cleanup errors, then publish authority; next ordinary frame entry is blocked.
RECOVER terminalQueued means real historical reserved-slot admission, not downstream sink admission or PC receipt; later queries recover last cached result.
RESTART now separately records Serial and network descriptor admission; manual reset escape remains independent of configuration/RECOVER reservation.
lockOrderNotes: Recovery: guaranteed reserve completes before recovery state lock; ACK/Complete release recovery lock before guaranteed operations. No nested inverse pair found.
Queries copy state under one short critical section and format outside it.
Serial pool/stats and transport stats critical sections end before potentially blocking USB/stdio/network calls.
notRun: Target compile/flash by this reviewer; parent owns unified build/flash.
Real USB no-reader/replug, USB+BLE load, UDP flood and CPU0 WDT HIL.
Physical analog safety or host receipt confirmation.
remainingValidationConditions: Checkpoint bounds time between safe call boundaries only: one SDK call/formatting unit is not time-bounded by this component. The host 500us/unit scheduler model does not prove target idle timing. Measure SCHED idleAge/maxIdleGap and all seven worker counters under USB/BLE/WiFi load.
Priority queue rejection and physical USB disconnect can still drop whole records; counters plus CRC/identity/query recovery are required. No exactly-once or PC-receipt guarantee.
